decisions.reason: Allowing JLCPCB Advanced components does not change the AXP2101 exposed-pad heat-transfer requirement or its assembly behavior.
The source changes the general component-selection policy but does not select a different regulator or alter the standalone USB power behavior.
The decision to permit Advanced components does not alter the existing fact that the legacy standalone main-board layer stack is superseded.
Although nearby context discusses connector availability, the source does not change the required panel controls, connector inventory, connector types, or signal assignments.
Permitting Advanced components where Basic alternatives are unavailable does not change the 5V rail's enable control, converter behavior, routing, or powered loads.
The source does not change the charge-status display method, external charge-LED interface, connector specification, resistance, or population requirements.
The component-selection policy does not alter the existing supersession of the legacy standalone main-board dimensions and routing constraints.
